# TSBS DevOps — Low Memory Hosts

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Hosts with low available memory

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT hostname, MIN(available_percent) as min_avail_pct
FROM mem
WHERE time >= '2024-01-02 02:00:00'
  AND time < '2024-01-02 03:00:00'
GROUP BY hostname
HAVING MIN(available_percent) < 10
ORDER BY min_avail_pct
```
